cases.study_information: Rank all ten IL-17A/F IgG1-YTE antibodies from highest to lowest terminal half-life after IV dosing in cynomolgus monkeys. VH/VL sequences, human IL-17A/F binding and two functional assays are visible. The Fc is fixed with M252Y/S254T/T256E. The experiment used a single 50 mg/kg IV dose, four animals per group and sampling through day 49. The reference antibody had an IV half-life of 9.2 days. All target animal results are withheld; human allometric simulations are not the endpoint.
